test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Numerical Ability (Held on: 24 Nov, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: Under a scheme, a vendor is selling an article at a discount of 20% on the marked price; furthermore, he is offering a cash discount of Rs. 170. Now he is earning a profit of 10%. Determine the marked price of the article if its cost price is Rs. 1,300.
solution:
**Given:**

Cost price (CP) of the article = Rs. 1300

Discount = 20%

Cash discount = Rs. 170

Profit = 10%

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price (SP) = CP × (1 + Profit %)

Marked Price (MP) = SP / (1 - Discount %) + Cash Discount

**Calculation:**

Selling Price (SP) = 1300 × (1 + 0.10)

⇒ SP = 1300 × 1.10 = Rs. 1430

Marked Price (MP) = (SP + Cash Discount) / (1 - Discount %)

⇒ MP = (1430 + 170) / (1 - 0.20)

⇒ MP = 1600 / 0.80 = Rs. 2000

**The marked price of the article is Rs. 2000.**
